jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Implementation & Training
jobs.description:
Position Summary
  
The Sr. Manager, Implementation & Training owns the how of field enablement for new initiatives. This role ensures field leaders and practice teams have clear, practical guidance, training, tools, and implementation resources needed to successfully execute changes.
  
  
Position Purpose
  
The position translates operational initiatives into usable field-facing support. Working closely with the Director, Field Execution and relevant subject-matter experts, this leader ensures training and implementation materials are aligned to rollout plans, delivered at the right time, and improved based on field feedback.
  
  
Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  
Implementation Enablement
  

* Define the practical tools and resources required to support successful execution of assigned initiatives.
* Develop implementation guides, checklists, job aids, FAQs, scripts, and other field-facing resources as needed.
* Ensure implementation guidance is clear, actionable, and appropriate for the intended audience.

Training Planning & Delivery
  

* Plan and coordinate training for field leaders and practice teams in support of enterprise initiatives.
* Facilitate training sessions, level-up sessions, town halls, and train-the-trainer programs as appropriate.
* Align training timing and reinforcement with the overall field rollout plan.

Content & Subject-Matter Coordination
  

* Partner with HR and appropriate subject-matter experts on training content development and accuracy.
* Translate complex processes and decisions into practical field-facing guidance.
* Maintain consistency and version control across implementation materials.

Field Feedback & Continuous Improvement
  

* Gather feedback from field leaders and practice teams during pilots and after implementation.
* Identify recurring questions, barriers, and gaps in understanding.
* Refine materials and enablement approaches based on field feedback and implementation learnings.

Readiness & Sustainment Support
  

* Provide training and materials readiness input throughout implementation planning and launch.
* Support post-launch reinforcement where additional enablement is needed.
* Coordinate appropriate handoff of ongoing materials and training needs once an initiative moves into sustainment.

Travel Requirements
  
This role is primarily remote; however, periodic travel to field locations may be required to support implementation efforts, gain firsthand understanding of operational needs, strengthen field partnership, and ensure successful delivery of key initiatives.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 6+ years of experience in implementation, training, operations enablement, field support, or a related discipline.
* Experience leading programs, projects, or significant cross-functional initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering training or implementation support for multi-location teams.
* Strong facilitation, presentation, written communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to translate complex processes into clear and practical guidance.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience in multi-site healthcare, dental, retail, or another distributed organization.
* Experience with learning platforms, adoption tracking, or learning management systems.
* Experience supporting enterprise change or implementation initiatives.

Measures of Success
  

* Field teams receive clear and practical resources needed to execute new initiatives.
* Training and implementation materials are aligned to rollout timing.
* Common field questions and barriers are identified and addressed quickly.
* Materials improve over time based on implementation feedback.
* Field leaders and teams demonstrate stronger readiness for new processes and initiatives.

jobs.title: Implementation Analyst
jobs.description:
EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified *E360 RCM*™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M+ processed claims, and expert human-in-the-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out-of-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's #1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years.

**Position Summary**

The Implementation Analyst will support the integration process clients for into EnableComp high-performance product suite. The IA will support activities associated with new client implementations and internal initiatives, and will help coordinate various tasks for on-boarding clients into the EnableComp service suite. The IA will help support senior managers with project timelines, deliverables, setting client expectations, communicating regularly and elevating critical issues.

* Escalate change requests and issues effectively

* Use of independent judgement and discretion as it relates to responsibilities detailed above.
* Other duties as required

* Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent experience required.
* 2+ years’ experience with implementation and/or technical project management in a healthcare setting.
* Revenue Cycle experience a plus.
* General understanding and exposure to technical systems and relational databases a plus.
* Experience with project management tools required.
* Technical proficiency with project portfolio management tools, support ticketing software, and cloud-based document sharing systems.
* Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
* Must have strong computer proficiency and understand how to use basic office applications, including MS Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
* Regular and predictable attendance.
* To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

### **Special Considerations and Prerequisites**

* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and changing work environment.
* Collaborative, customer-focused and able to create visible value.
* Team approach to working with others, ability to perform a variety of duties within any workday and organizational skills from planning to execution of tasks and projects.
* Project coordination experience.
* Process oriented with the ability to drive a project to successful completion.
* Proven track record of conflict management and problem solving skills
* Ability to work independently (self-directed/resourceful) and as a team member.
* Excellent communication and client facing skills.
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Technical aptitude.

All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. jobs.title: Brand Implementation & Production Manager
jobs.description:
We are Builders FirstSource, America’s largest supplier of building materials, value-added components and building services to the professional market. You’ll feel proud of the work you do here every day to transform the future of home building and help make the dream of home ownership more achievable. At BFS, we believe building a successful career is not solely defined by a degree. Your experience, skills, and passion are just as important, if not more so. As such, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that welcomes candidates from all backgrounds and experience levels.
  
  
PURPOSE
  
  
The Brand Implementation & Production Manager is responsible for consistent execution of approved brand standards across Builders FirstSource and its family of brands, including locations, signage, fleet, printed materials, and other physical brand assets. This role serves as the bridge between brand strategy and execution, overseeing the production, deployment, and implementation of brand initiatives while maintaining compliance with brand standards.
  
  
The position partners closely with Marketing, Creative, Communications, Sales, Digital, Operations, Procurement, and external vendors to manage brand rollouts, signage, marketing collateral, events, promotional materials, and integrated campaigns.
  
  
The role is also responsible for managing key print and production partners and coordinates Marketing’s involvement in acquisition and integration initiatives.
  
  
This is a remote position.
  
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Brand Implementation
  

* Lead the implementation and execution of approved brand standards across Builders FirstSource and its family of brands, including locations, signage, fleet graphics, environmental branding, and printed materials.
* Translate brand standards and creative direction into production specifications, vendor instructions, and implementation plans.
* Ensure consistent application of brand standards, messaging, and visual identity across markets, channels, and business units.
* Review proofs, samples, and completed work for accuracy, quality, and brand compliance.
* Coordinate physical rebranding for acquisitions, location conversions, and consolidations, working with Facilities, Real Estate, Operations and local teams to address site and installation requirements.
* Develop and maintain brand implementation tools, guidelines, templates, and best practices.
* Support large-scale brand launches, refreshes, rebrands, and acquisition integrations.

Print and Production Management
  

* Oversee production and deployment of marketing materials, signage, printed collateral, promotional merchandise, event materials, and branded assets. Manage relationships with printers, fabrication vendors, promotional suppliers, agencies, and production partners.
* Lead print-production planning for major company events, trade shows, executive meetings, and other Marketing initiatives.
* Coordinate specifications, estimates, proofs, production schedules, shipping, installation, and quality control for major or complex projects.
* Establish clear processes for routine orders while maintaining brand and budget controls.
* Monitor vendor performance and identify opportunities to improve network of vendors, with a focus on cost, quality, service, and production efficiency.

M&A Marketing Coordination
  

* Serve as Marketing’s primary day-to-day liaison to the M&A and integration teams, participating in planning meetings to understand timing, business requirements, and brand implications.
* Identify acquisition-related Marketing needs, including physical rebranding and required website, social media, communications and other updates.
* Engage the appropriate Marketing teams and track deliverables, owners and deadlines, providing status updates and escalating issues as needed.
* Provide implementation guidance and support for local market and enterprise brand initiatives.

Project Management and Cross-Functional Coordination
  

* Manage assigned work through established Marketing intake, prioritization, and project-management processes, maintaining accurate schedules and status updates.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and documentation for recurring implementation and production activities.
* Coordinate purchase orders, invoices, and related documentation with the appropriate internal teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of marketing and branding initiatives.
* Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and aligned with business objectives.
* Track project milestones, budget performance, and resource allocation.
* Leads vendors, agencies, and cross-functional project teams through assigned initiatives.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

* This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Project Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 4 years experience in brand implementation, marketing production, print production, signage, project management, or a related field.
* Or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Experience managing print, signage, large-format graphics, or related production vendors.
* Experience managing estimates, proofs, production schedules, shipping, and installation requirements.
* Experience supporting acquisition integrations, multisite organizations, or distributed field teams preferred.
* Familiarity with digital asset management systems and Adobe Creative Suite preferred.

COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, locations, and deadlines.
* Working knowledge of brand standards, print-production requirements, and production-quality control.
* Strong project-management and organizational skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, consistency, and quality.
* Practical understanding of how brand standards translate into production and physical implementation.
* Ability to evaluate estimates, specifications, proofs, and vendor recommendations.
* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to establish accountability and move work forward across teams without direct authority.
* Proactive, dependable, and able to maintain clear visibility across multiple initiatives.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project-management or work-management platforms.

BFS BUILT TO LEAD COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Know the Business
* Builds deep knowledge of BFS’s operating model and financial drivers, market position and the industry landscape to make informed decisions that create value.
* Focus on the Customer
* Anticipates customer needs, applies insights to decision-making and drives customer-centric solutions that create business value.
* Plan for Tomorrow
* Thinks strategically, anticipates future challenges and positions the business for long-term success.
* Earn Trust
* Acts with humility, integrity and authenticity so others —inside and outside BFS — know they can count on you.
* Model Empathy
* Listens actively, respects different perspectives and fosters a workplace where people feel valued and supported.
* Succeed Together
* Builds and strengthens partnerships inside and outside BFS by collaborating, aligning efforts and driving shared success.
* Deliver Results
* Consistently meet or exceed goals through effective execution and accountability.
* Continuously Improve & Innovate
* Seek new ideas and approaches to enhance processes and outcomes.
* Embrace Change
* Adapt quickly to evolving priorities and drive positive transformation.
* Invest in the Team
* Support growth and development through coaching, feedback, and opportunities.
* Attract & Hire the Best
* Identify and recruit top talent aligned with organizational values and goals.
* Adopt a Growth Mindset
* Demonstrate curiosity, resilience, and openness to learning and improvement.

WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL ACTIVITY
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  

* Subject to both typical office environment and outside locations with temperature and weather variations.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 pounds frequently and on occasion up to 80 pounds.
* Occasional travel may be required.

Successful, innovative, and fulfilling careers are built here, and your professional development is a high priority. We invest in your future through the latest training, tools, and technologies. Highly collaborative, we work together to solve problems and find better ways to continually grow our business and careers every day. You’ll be empowered to try new things, gain new experiences, and build a career with unlimited horizons. The scale and depth of resources that being the #1 building materials distributor in the nation provides a variety of opportunities for you to explore – all in a friendly, people-first environment. Join us to be more, do more, and build more, together at BFS.
  
At Builders FirstSource, we offer competitive, affordable benefits designed to make life better for you and the people you love. Our goal is simple — provide great plans that help you and your family to live happier, healthier and more secure lives. To view all our benefit offerings click here www.bldrbenefits.com.
  
  
Builders FirstSource is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, protected veteran status or status as an individual with a disability.
  
In compliance with the ADA Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position with Builders FirstSource, please call (214) 765-3990 or email: ADA.Accommodation@bldr.com. Please do not send resumes to this email address - it is intended only to be used to request an accommodation in submitting an application for a job opening.
  
Please note that due to the volume of applications received, we are unable to respond to individual inquiries about the status of your application.

jobs.title: Manager, Enterprise Implementation
jobs.description:
Motus is the complete solution for managing employee driving, built for smarter personal vehicle use. With more than 90 years of proven expertise, Motus brings together reimbursement, risk mitigation, and advanced analytics into one platform that helps organizations maximize field team productivity, optimize vehicle spend, and reduce corporate risk exposure. Backed by unmatched benchmark data and time-tested best practices, Motus supports more than 700,000 drivers across 3,000+ companies and remains the trusted leader in employee driving programs.

At Motus, we're dedicated to making WorkLife better for everyone, anywhere. Our team is the heart of our culture, and we live by our WorkLife Pillars every day – WorkHappy, WorkHealthy, WorkSmart, WorkAnywhere, and WorkTogether.

**Position Description:**

The Motus Implementation Team is the leading force behind Motus' customer onboarding, and we are looking for a Manager, Enterprise Implementation. You will develop and mentor the team to complete project management processes effectively while consulting with our customers on standard methodologies, and resulting in excellent customer satisfaction and product adoption.

The ideal candidate must be comfortable managing a team of high-performing individuals with the ability to roll up their sleeves to ensure outstanding customer experience and satisfaction. To succeed in this role, you must possess strong communication and organizational skills and an unwavering dedication to your peers and our customers. You will need to always be looking at opportunities for efficiency and scalability for customer implementations. This role will provide you with the opportunity to work cross-functionally with other Motus departments.

**Position Duties:**

* Oversee a team of Implementation Specialists and Analysts who consult on Motus's product suite and follow standard methodologies for successful customer onboarding in Enterprise and Strategic implementations.
* Report on customer satisfaction survey levels to identify coaching opportunities and maintain departmental satisfaction level objectives.
* Responsible for the success of your team; identifying real-time coaching opportunities, providing mentorship and timely feedback, and acknowledging successes.
* Supervise and report on team metrics and capacity to the Director of Implementation
* Find opportunities to scale and standardize processes for Enterprise and Strategic implementations
* Review client list & in-flight projects with your team, ensuring projects are on track, accurate, etc.
* Mentor and guide specialists through stabilizing At Risk projects, joining calls to support complex conversations
* Provide feedback and enhancement requests to other departments for roadmap improvements (i.e. Product, Marketing) on behalf of the Implementation team.
* In partnership with the Enablement team, effectively train and onboard new teammates.
* Support customers in resolving blocking issues and contribute to the follow-up of Implementation Satisfaction Survey responses.
* Actively provide verbal and written feedback to team members in one-on-one check-ins.
* Score team members calls on a consistent cadence to ensure standards are being maintained.
* Ensure team critical metric measurements and reporting is up to date
* Ensure team project templates are up-to-date in project management software
* Work alongside other leaders to ensure continuity between teams and processes
* Partner with sales leaders to support pre-contract conversations and allow for cohesive hand-offs between teams.
* Research new tools and applications in the market to ensure Motus is current with SaaS processes & industry standards.
* Travel to On-Site Implementation Kick-Offs 1-3 times per quarter.

**Desired Skills & Experience:**

* 3-5 years of experience implementing and/or supporting the largest and most sophisticated, complex accounts in a B2B SaaS environment.
* 3+ years of experience successfully leading a team, managing performance, and mentoring team members
* Champion of process improvements and use of technology to scale team processes.
* Proven record of supporting customers through complex change management especially for employee populations
* Proven success supporting team changes and their cross functional impacts
* Experience in project management software tools
* Possess a strong leadership presence.
* Promote a positive team culture while holding team members accountable
* Effective and self-assured presenter, with a keen understanding of business dynamics
* Strong persuasion skills and ability to articulate the value of Motus' solutions.
* Ability to clearly articulate sophisticated solutions in a simplified manner.
* Drive and dedication to get the job done.
* Demonstrate organizational, analytical, and project management skills

Where required by law, Motus provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The pay range for this role is $95,000 - $105,000**.** Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications. This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short-and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally required benefits.

Please see below for an outline of the Motus benefits package. Motus supports both the physical and mental health of their employees.

**Motus Benefits:**

* Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance (effective day one)
* Open Paid Time Off
* Flexible Spending Accounts & Health Savings Accounts
* Motus-Fidelity 401K Plan
* Company-paid Short/Long-term Disability & Basic Life Insurance Plans
* Family Planning and Parenting Support Benefits through Maven
* Support your mental, physical, professional and financial well-being through coaching and clinical therapy with Modern Health
* $1000 Home Office Reimbursement Program
* $2000 Internal Referral Program
* WorkAnywhere Reimbursement of Internet and Cellular Costs
* 16 weeks maternity and adoption leave
* 12 weeks paternity leave

Motus champions the power of true individuality, actively celebrating and accepting each team member. We strategically recruit and retain talent reflecting our local communities' rich diversity, fostering a culture where innovation thrives. Through dynamic learning sessions, strategic training, and our lively Employee Resource Groups, we kindle substantial dialogues, continuous learning, and ensure every voice is not only heard but celebrated.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** Balance FMS is a financial management services (FMS) organization focused on helping clients manage their personal assistance and in-home support services with clarity and control. The company supports individuals and families by handling key administrative, financial, and compliance-related tasks so clients can focus on daily life rather than paperwork. Balance FMS works closely with state programs, vendors, and service providers to ensure accurate, timely payments and streamlined onboarding processes. Team members at Balance FMS contribute to a service-oriented environment that values reliability, accuracy, and respect for diverse client needs

**REMOTE Part-Time FMS Administrative & Vendor Onboarding Specialist**

**Balance FMS, LLC | Approximately 5 hours per week | $26-30 per hour, depending on experience. Hours and role and can grow as the company grows.**

Balance FMS is a growing Financial Management Services (FMS) provider supporting individuals and families in California’s Self-Determination Program. We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on team member to help our Managing Director with vendor onboarding, compliance documentation, and day-to-day administrative work.

* Handle assigned vendor onboarding from first contact through completion. Review the service being provided, confirm which documents are needed, collect missing items, and keep the vendor and family informed.

* Help resolve vendor billing and payment questions, document arrangements, and follow up on outstanding items.

* Help complete DDS and regional center documentation, including gathering records and following through on items identified during compliance reviews.

Hands-on experience supporting FMS operations in California’s Self-Determination Program is required, along with familiarity with regional center processes and California Department of Developmental Services (DDS) requirements. Candidates should have experience with vendor onboarding and compliance documentation, be comfortable communicating with families and providers, and be able to manage follow-up independently. Airtable experience is helpful.

**To apply**, please send your résumé and a brief description of your California FMS experience, including which parts of vendor onboarding or compliance you personally handled.

jobs.title: Field Service Software Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Business Development Resources (BDR)** is the premier provider of business training and coaching services to HVAC contractors. Our goal is simple: empower our clients with our industry experience and information to give them the knowledge and skills they need to drive profit and growth in their business. We are currently looking for a Field Service Software Onboarding Specialist to join our team.

**Reports to:** Lead Software Integrator  
  
**FLSA Status:** Non-Exempt  
  
**Work Hours:** 7:00 am-4:00 pm Monday Friday, some overtime may be required.
  
  
**Pay Scale:** $29.00 - $36 per hour  
  
**Position Summary:** The Field Service Software Onboarding Specialist is a client-facing role that helps clients engage with BDR's field service software services and the BDR Field Service Portal. The role is the first point of contact for client and internal software questions, guides clients through onboarding, audit findings, and dashboard insights, completes defined account-structure setup, and escalates requests to a Software Optimization Specialist or Enterprise Solutions Specialist when needed.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field OR 3+ years relevant experience
* ServiceTitan or other field service platform experience.
* Client support, customer success, implementation, or project coordination experience.
* Experience writing professional responses or knowledge base content.
* Understanding of field service operations, maintenance agreements, dispatch, business units, and operational reporting.
* Comfort with Microsoft 365, virtual meeting platforms, and CRM or project-tracking tools.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Written and verbal communication that explains software concepts clearly.
* Organization, documentation, prioritization, and follow-through.
* Disciplined research: testing understanding, evaluating sources, and giving supported answers.
* Facilitating virtual calls with effective discovery questions.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Onboard new clients to the BDR Field Service Portal, explaining its resources, dashboard features, support process, and next steps.
* Coordinate contacts, access, required information, and meetings, and follow up on open items.
* Research and answer client and internal software questions with clear, accurate, actionable guidance, validated against documentation, internal standards, and team experts.
* Document questions, responses, and follow-ups; recommend knowledge-resource updates when questions recur.
* Lead virtual onboarding calls for standard software optimizations, covering process, timeline, access, and client responsibilities.
* Gather account structure, workflow, user, and reporting information, and document risks, open questions, and next steps for the Software Optimization Specialist.

* Validate and document changes, communicate client actions or training needs, and complete quality-control checks.
* Other duties as assigned

**Why work for us?:**

* Medical, DentalVision Insurance provided with minimal employee contribution
* 401K with a company match
* Paid Vacation Days
* Paid Sick Days
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Training

jobs.title: Fractional Implementation Project Specialist
jobs.description:
**ABOUT FORJ**

Forj is a single solution for community and learning, purpose-built to modernize the member experience for associations and professional networks — serving over 300 organizations and a million professionals who rely on us to connect, learn, and grow. We’re a remote-first company headquartered in Delafield, Wisconsin, united not by a shared office but by a shared belief that the professionals who make our world better deserve better. We forge ahead with boldness and determination, but we know great work comes from people who feel trusted and supported — flexibility isn’t a perk here, it’s how we operate. Our five core values — ***We Forge Ahead, We Innovate, We Build Relationships, We Learn and Grow Always, We Win Together*** — aren’t just words; they’re how we show up for each other every day. We care about you as a person, not just a professional. We laugh, we celebrate, and we have each other’s backs. If you’re driven by meaningful work and a team that’s genuinely in it together, you belong here.

**ABOUT THE ENGAGEMENT**

Forj is seeking an experienced Implementation Project Specialist to provide fractional project coordination support for our client implementations. Our clients are launching Forj Connect, Forj Learn and Journey by Forj, often while migrating from other platforms and connecting to their association management systems (AMS). You will keep implementations organized and moving by maintaining project plans, documenting client meetings, tracking action items and following up so nothing falls through the cracks. You’ll collaborate with our Implementation Specialists, who lead configuration, integrations and client delivery, and our Client Success Managers, who own client strategy and the relationship.

**HOW THIS ENGAGEMENT WORKS**

This is a fractional contract engagement estimated at **15 to 20 hours per week**. You decide when, where and how you work. The one exception is scheduled client calls and internal project meetings, which take priority: we expect you to attend them reliably and plan the rest of your work around them. Beyond those commitments, success is measured by delivering the services and outcomes in this scope of work, not by when you’re online or what hours you keep. Response times and communication norms will be agreed on at the start of the engagement so clients and the Forj team always know what to expect.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Set up and maintain implementation project plans in Planhat, and keep dates and tasks current as changes are confirmed with the Implementation Specialist
* Schedule client meetings, prepare agendas from open action items, document notes, and deliver a written recap within 24 hours covering decisions, actions, owners and dates
* Maintain risk, decision and change request logs, and promptly flag potential delays or new client requests to the Implementation Specialist
* Track progress toward project milestones (kickoff, plan approval, configuration sign-off, migration sign-off, user acceptance testing and go-live), and collect required approvals and documentation
* Follow up with clients on outstanding items such as data exports, single sign-on (SSO) setup, DNS changes and access to client technical contacts
* Track cross-functional tasks across Implementation, Product, Engineering, Training and Client Success, send reminders ahead of due dates, and raise blockers with the Implementation Specialist or Director of Client Operations
* Prepare launch and handoff documentation for the Client Success Manager, including open issues, decisions and project records
* Recommend improvements to implementation templates, checklists and automation, including AI-assisted call recaps and status reporting

  

**EXPECTED OUTCOMES**

*Success in this engagement is measured by the outcomes below*

  

* Supporting 2–3 active implementations within the first 30 days, and a full coordination workload by month three
* Reliable attendance at scheduled client calls and internal project meetings
* Accurate, current project plans and logs in Planhat, with recaps delivered within 24 hours of every client call
* Consistent tracking and follow-up on client action items, reducing delays caused by missed or forgotten tasks
* Reduced scheduling, documentation and follow-up load on Implementation Specialists
* Practical recommendations for improving templates, checklists and handoff documentation

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

  

* **Highly organized:** you keep many moving parts tracked and up to date
* **Detail-oriented:** you catch missed dates, open items and inconsistencies before they become problems
* **Self-directed:** you manage your own time and deliver reliably without close oversight
* **Clear communicator:** your recaps and reminders are concise, accurate and easy to act on
* **Curious about technology:** you don’t need to write code, but you have a working knowledge of how SSO, migrations and integrations work and can quickly get up to speed on new systems.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3-5 years of experience in project coordination, implementation, onboarding or operations support, ideally in a SaaS environment
* Experience tracking tasks, timelines and action items across multiple projects at once
* Strong written communication, including meeting notes, recaps and status updates
* Comfortable with project and customer success tools (e.g., Planhat or similar, Jira, HubSpot, Zoom)
* Familiarity with SSO, data migrations or system integrations is beneficial
* Experience with association, nonprofit or membership organizations, AMS platforms (e.g., iMIS, NetForum, Fonteva, Nimble), or community and learning (LMS) platforms is beneficial
* Proficiency using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to work more efficiently, with good judgment in reviewing and owning AI-generated content
* CAPM or similar project coordination certification is beneficial

  

**ENGAGEMENT REQUIREMENTS**

* Operates as an independent business or sole proprietor and provides a W-9
* Legally able to provide services in the United States
* Provides own computer, internet access and workspace
* Able to collaborate with a distributed team across time zones
* Able to sign Forj’s independent contractor agreement, including confidentiality and data protection terms

jobs.title: Innovation and Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Our capabilities span strategic communications, technology, training, program management, and organizational improvement. We bring together experienced professionals who combine creative thinking with disciplined execution to help clients achieve measurable results.  
  
We help clients develop programs, introduce new technologies, engage stakeholders, and equip people with the knowledge and resources to succeed. Our work with the Department of Veterans Affairs supports initiatives that improve the Veteran experience. We welcome professionals who bring sound judgment, fresh ideas, and a commitment to delivering useful, reliable work.

**Position Overview**
=====================

Working under the direction of the assigned Pod Lead or Implementation Lead, the Specialist provides hands-on research, analysis, coordination, and implementation support across concurrent DRHCI initiatives. The Innovation and Implementation Specialist carries the business case for each assigned project from its start to its transition. At the front end, market research that validates the problem and establishes the project charter; at the back end, develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard, updated market research, analysis of alternatives, and budget estimates that a project needs to transition to the Digital Health Office for enterprise scaling.  
The role contributes throughout the innovation lifecycle from understanding the problem and assessing local readiness to supporting pilots, gathering feedback, refining implementation approaches, and preparing resources for continued use. The Specialist applies sound judgment to assess information, identify gaps, and recommend practical solutions appropriate to the intended users and implementation setting.  
For assigned business-process activities, the Specialist carries forward the evidence and assumptions supporting a project’s business case from initial problem validation through pilot results and consideration for enterprise scaling. The role coordinates market research, project charters, value scorecards, and resource estimates, drawing on the data and evaluation team for measurement methodology and validated outcome data.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Supports market research for assigned projects, partnering with innovators to complete the Market Research Guide validating the problem, quantifying scope and impact, and assessing the market landscape to determine best value for VA.
* Coordinates creation of Project Charters outlining scope, resources, roles, and responsibilities to authorize and structure each assigned project.
* Develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard for assigned projects transitioning to DHO, including measured impact against baseline and validated cost savings and ROI supported by evidence.
* Summarizes lessons learned, changes to assumptions, and unintended consequences for assigned projects.
* Socializes the business case with DHO and relevant local and national parties, gathering feedback and adapting scope as necessary.
* Updates market research to account for new analyses of alternatives and projected demand within VA as a project matures.
* Reassesses resource and funding needs for scaling, including additional costs for communications, training, and evaluation support, and produces budget estimate reporting.
* Contributes to the shared tracking system with DHO monitoring projects in transition and those accepted into the scaling pipeline.
* Works with the Data & Evaluation Lead to ensure the metrics and baselines committed at charter are the ones the business case will need at the end. Supports coordination meetings with DHO and relevant program offices to review scaling pipeline candidates and align priorities.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================

This position has no formal supervisory responsibility. The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned work, collaborate effectively, maintain accurate status information, and communicate barriers early.  
The role may coordinate working sessions and contributions from multiple stakeholders. Decisions involving clinical practice, technology configuration, security authorization, procurement, resource commitments, or changes in scope are elevated to the appropriate authorized personnel.  
For business-process assignments, the Specialist works with the assigned innovation pod lead and designated data and evaluation personnel to maintain consistency between project assumptions, measurement methods, validated results, and scaling recommendations. Approval of project charters, funding commitments, procurement approaches, and enterprise scaling remains with authorized personnel.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Five or more years in business analysis, program analysis, or management consulting involving business case development.
* Demonstrated experience conducting market research or analysis of alternatives to support a build, buy, or reuse decision.
* Experience developing a business case with cost and benefit analysis that a skeptical reviewer accepted.
* Experience producing project charters and structuring project scope, roles, and responsibilities.
* Ability to work with quantitative evaluation data without owning the analysis, and to represent it honestly including its limits.
* Strong written communication for executive audiences.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools, including Microsoft Teams and SharePoint, and the ability to learn required tracking and reporting platforms.
* Ability to obtain a VA background investigation or public trust determination.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting digital health, telehealth, remote patient monitoring, connected devices, or other healthcare innovations.
* Experience supporting pilot programs, site-readiness assessments, workflow improvement, or multisite implementation.
* Familiarity with implementation science, human-centered design, change management, or continuous quality improvement methods.
* Experience developing implementation toolkits, process guides, readiness checklists, or sustainment resources.
* Experience engaging clinicians, operational staff, Veterans, caregivers, or other healthcare stakeholders.
* Familiarity with barriers affecting rural populations, people with disabilities, or users with varying levels of digital literacy.
* Experience working within agile, sprint-based, or multidisciplinary project teams.
* Experience supporting VA, other federal healthcare organizations, or Veteran-facing programs.

**Credentials and VA Experience**
=================================

No professional certification or prior VA experience is required.  
Relevant training or certification in implementation science, project management, change management, human-centered design, Lean Six Sigma, or quality improvement is preferred.

**Performance Expectations**
============================

Successful performance is demonstrated through:

* Accurate research and useful, well-supported recommendations.
* Timely completion of assigned implementation activities and resources.
* Early identification and escalation of readiness gaps and delivery barriers.
* Effective coordination with participating sites and interdisciplinary contributors.
* Clear documentation of progress, feedback, adaptations, and lessons learned.
* Practical resources that support adoption, sustained operations, and approved replication.
* Traceable business cases and value scorecards that connect initial assumptions, validated pilot results, resource estimates, and recommendations for enterprise scaling.

**Location and Travel**
=======================

The position is remote from company-approved work locations. Periodic travel to VA facilities, implementation sites, demonstrations, or team meetings may be required based on approved client and project needs.

**Location and Remote Work**
============================

Pathways 2 Solutions is a fully remote government contracting organization. Employees may work remotely from approved states where the company is authorized to employ personnel and can meet payroll, tax, regulatory, security, and contractual requirements. At this time, applicants must reside and perform their remote work in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, North Carolina, Tennessee, or Texas, with business travel to approved event locations as required.  
  
The position may require periodic travel to VA facilities, government offices, implementation sites, or team meetings. Travel is expected to be up to 15%, depending on client requirements. Pathways reserves the right to modify approved work locations based on business needs and applicable legal, tax, regulatory, and contractual requirements.

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements**
==============================================

This position involves prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. The employee must be able to communicate effectively in virtual meetings and occasionally lift or move materials weighing up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

**Compensation and Benefits**
=============================

The anticipated salary range is $115,000–$130,000 annually. Actual compensation will be based on education, relevant experience, communications and implementation expertise, credentials, work location, internal equity, and applicable contract and funding parameters.  
Pathways offers a collaborative, family-oriented workplace culture, opportunities for professional growth, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan; paid time off; and other benefits available under applicable company plans and policies.

**Employment Requirements and Equal Opportunity**
=================================================

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Pathways is currently unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment visa.  
Pathways is dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment and providing equal opportunity for individuals of all abilities. Applicants who require assistance or an accommodation at any stage of the application process because of a disability or medical condition may contact HR Director Terri Baxter at terri.baxter@pw2s.com.  
Pathways is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women, minorities, veterans, and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Pathways is committed to a safe, healthy, and productive work environment for employees and others.  
At Pathways, no one works in a box. We nurture and leverage individual talents, encourage continual growth, and offer creative freedom, a collaborative environment, and a variety of challenging assignments.

Pathways 2 Solutions Inc. is dedicated to providing equal opportunity for individuals of all abilities. If you require assistance or need accommodation at any stage of the application process because of a disability or medical condition, please feel free to email terri.baxter@pw2s.com.  
  
Pathways has a policy of maintaining a workplace free of drugs and alcohol. Pathways ensures a safe, healthy, and productive work environment for its employees and others. All applicants are advised that full compliance with this policy is a condition of employment at Pathways.  
  
Applicants must have authorization to work for any employer in the United States. We are currently unable to sponsor or to take over sponsorship of an employment visa.  
  
Pathways is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We invite applications from all interested individuals, including veterans and persons with disabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Implementation (Equity)
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at **insightsoftware.com.**

**Job Description:**

**About Us**
============

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com .

**Job Summary**
===============

The Senior Consultant, Equity Administration & Financial Reconciliation is a highly skilled, detail-oriented equity and financial reporting professional within insightsoftware’s Professional Services organization. This role is crucial to ensuring the accurate reconciliation of both financial reporting data for equity compensation and administrative equity data as customers migrate from their current equity management platform to the NextGen platform.

On the financial side, you will own the reconciliation of ASC 718 stock compensation expense, corporate tax, disclosures, and ASC 260 diluted EPS. On the administrative side, you will reconcile participant- and grant-level equity data — balances, lifecycle events, and transaction history — between the legacy platform and NextGen. Across both, you will develop and deliver comparison reports, analyze discrepancies, and produce comprehensive reconciliation documentation. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who takes initiative, thinks critically, and operates effectively across systems and teams with minimal oversight. You will be a senior point of contact on assigned workstreams, partner directly with customer stakeholders, and lead by example — mentoring more junior contributors and reliably delivering the most complex, high-stakes work.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Financial Reconciliation**
----------------------------

* Reconcile equity compensation financial reporting results between the customer’s prior results and NextGen, spanning ASC 718 stock compensation expense, corporate and deferred tax, disclosures, and ASC 260 diluted EPS.
* Develop and deliver comparison reports for each reconciliation cycle, including summary and detailed analysis of differences.
* Analyze comparison reports to identify and quantify calculation differences, determine root causes, and recommend resolutions.
* Provide clear reconciliation documentation that helps customers understand the differences, if any, between NextGen’s calculations and their previous methods.
* Apply a working knowledge of how fair values, accounting setup selections, and migrated data drive these outputs — other teams perform configuration and data loading — so differences can be explained and resolved.

**Administrative Reconciliation**
---------------------------------

* Reconcile participant- and grant-level equity data — grants, vesting schedules, exercises, releases, cancellations, forfeitures, and outstanding/exercisable balances — between the legacy platform and NextGen.
* Validate share balances and grant lifecycle events to confirm transaction history migrated completely and accurately.
* Reconcile ESPP enrollment, contribution, and purchase data, and confirm participant demographic, tax, and account information transferred correctly.
* Identify, quantify, and document administrative discrepancies and deltas, performing root-cause analysis and driving items to resolution.
* Produce administrative reconciliation comparison reports and maintain follow-up trackers of open items through closure.
* Partner with the financial reconciliation workstream to ensure administrative data ties back to expense, tax, disclosure, and EPS results.

**Cross-Functional Dependencies & Systems Thinking**
----------------------------------------------------

* Understand how the work of adjacent teams flows together — the team loading customer data, the product team building and evolving the NextGen platform, and the administrative and financial reconciliation workstreams — and how each affects your deliverables.
* Anticipate how data loading, system configuration, and platform changes impact reconciliation results and report accuracy, and coordinate proactively to unblock and align.
* Validate migrated and loaded data against expected results, surface discrepancies to the responsible team, and confirm fixes flow through correctly — without owning the loading or configuration itself.
* Document mapping logic, exceptions, and resolution steps to maintain a clear, auditable trail across teams.

**Client Engagement & Collaboration**
-------------------------------------

* Serve as a senior point of contact for customer stakeholders on assigned equity and reconciliation workstreams.
* Ensure deliverables meet defined SLAs and quality standards; proactively surface risks before they become issues.
* Anticipate how adjacent teams’ work affects your deliverables, and coordinate across cross-functional teams to unblock and align.
* Lead customer conversations and follow up with clear, actionable plans.
* Mentor and support more junior team members, reinforcing standards of accuracy and accountability.

**Job Requirements**
====================

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

**Experience**
--------------

* Minimum of five years of experience in financial accounting, with a focus on equity compensation management and reconciliation.
* Strong working knowledge of ASC 718 expense reporting, ASC 260 diluted EPS, corporate tax, and disclosure concepts, with the ability to apply them to reconciliations and report building (other teams own system configuration and data loading).
* Experience with administrative/participant-level equity reconciliation and equity-related disclosures and year-end tax reporting (W-2 inserts, Forms 3921 and 3922).
* Experience with equity management systems is desirable.
* Experience with data migration, mapping, and validation across financial and equity administration systems.

**Technical Proficiency**
-------------------------

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other financial software.
* Familiarity with equity management platforms and financial accounting systems.

**Skills & Attributes**
=======================

* **Critical Thinking & Problem Solving:** breaks down complex problems, reasons through ambiguity, and arrives at sound, defensible conclusions.
* **Initiative & Strong Ownership:** takes responsibility for outcomes end to end and drives work forward without needing to be managed.
* **Reconciliation Expertise:** skilled at both financial and administrative reconciliation, including discrepancy/delta identification and resolution.
* **Equity Compensation Knowledge:** solid grasp of equity compensation financial reporting and administration.
* **Data Migration, Mapping & Validation:** able to move, map, and validate data accurately across systems.
* **Technical Expertise:** uses DB querying/SQL, report generation, data analysis, and automation to work effectively. Leverages technology efficiently without being hand-held.
* **Cross-Team Dependency Awareness:** understands how adjacent teams’ work impacts their own and leverages it to anticipate, unblock, and align.
* **Systems-Level Thinking:** connects the dots across teams to see how upstream and downstream work affects deliverables, and acts on it.
* **Process Documentation & Tracking:** creates clear process documentation and SOPs, and maintains efficient, reliable tracking of work.
* **Clear Communication:** strong written and verbal communication, including status reporting, escalations, and meeting follow-ups.
* **Attention to Detail:** excellent accuracy and the ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* **Soft Skills:** communicates effectively with customers by email and in person to answer questions and lead conversations, then translates those conversations into clear action plans.

**Additional Information**
==========================

* This position may require occasional travel to customer sites.
This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful data migration and reconciliation.  

The salary range in United States of America for this position is 88,000.00 to 111,000.00 USD Annual.  
  

For sales roles, this range includes the commission target. For non-sales roles, this is a base salary only range; additional bonus eligibility may apply.

  

Your specific offer within this range will be determined by your skills, experience, and qualifications.

  

We are committed to pay transparency and fair compensation practices. If you have questions about our compensation approach, please don't hesitate to ask during the interview process.

  
  
  

**Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

  

Learn more about our high-energy, high-performance global team: Work With Us

insightsoftware About Us: Hear From Our Team

  

Background checks are required for employment with insightsoftware, where permitted by country, state/province.

  

At insightsoftware, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

jobs.title: Franchisee Onboarding Consultant
jobs.description:
Join the Goddard Systems, LLC (GSL) corporate team and help shape a nationally recognized leader in early childhood education!

GSL supports approximately 700+ Goddard School locations across the U.S., helping franchisees deliver high-quality, play-based learning to more than 100,000 children and families. Our corporate team drives the strategy, systems, and support that enable schools across the network to thrive.

**Position Overview**

The Franchisee Onboarding Consultant serves as the primary operational coach and consultant for franchisees entering The Goddard School system—through new franchise awards, new school development, or transfers of ownership. This role ensures smooth, compliant, and successful onboarding and transition experience while driving early enrollment growth and operational readiness.

From Building Permit or Letter of Intent (LOI) approval through 90 days post‑opening or post‑transfer, the Consultant partners closely with franchisees to guide school readiness milestones, surface and escalate risks, and build the capabilities required to operate a high‑performing, premium early childhood education school.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Franchisee Onboarding & Readiness**

* Lead a structured onboarding roadmap, ensuring timelines, milestones, and deliverables are executed as planned.
* Guide franchisees through operational and programming readiness standards, ensuring alignment with brand, licensing, and health and safety expectations (in collaboration with the health and safety team).
* Serve as the franchisee’s primary point of contact, proactively identifying and escalating risks to the Director, New Franchisee Training Program and internal partners.

**Licensing & Compliance Readiness**

* Monitor licensing progress and escalate risk when requirements, timelines, or approvals are at risk.
* Guide franchisees through licensing readiness milestones, including preparation for state licensing visits, health and safety inspections led by GSL, and required documentation.
* Provide ongoing guidance on childcare licensing requirements, background checks, ratio rules, health and safety standards, and state‑specific mandates.
* Maintain accurate documentation of compliance milestones for new schools and ownership transitions that occur via School Transfers.

**Enrollment Growth & Market Activation** Help franchisees develop and activate local marketing, community engagement, and enrollment plans aligned to opening and enrollment targets.

* Coach franchisees on lead generation, local marketing tactics, community partnerships, and high‑conversion tour experiences.
* Orient franchisees to FMS, Wonder of Learning including The Goddard Family Hub and outlining parent communication expectations.
* Monitor enrollment progress against targets, surfacing and escalating risk relative to opening dates and upcoming enrollment periods.
* Analyze enrollment and marketing data to identify gaps, adjust tactics, and implement corrective action plans when needed.
* Introduce tools that the franchise consultant will utilize such as the Annual Business Review, System Standards Review and Wonder of Learning Review (TBD)
* Ensure classrooms are tour ready, supporting the Wonder of Learning program, shelves contain learning materials and the school and classrooms are inviting.

**Staffing & Operational Capacity Planning**

* Provide guidance on staffing models to include recruitment marketing and hiring timelines to support enrollment growth and operational readiness. Franchisee conducts all hiring activities.
* Assess staffing plans in relation to licensing, ratios, enrollment pacing, and financial sustainability.
* Coach franchisees on leadership readiness, staff onboarding, and early operational routines.

**Transfer of Ownership & Changeover Support**

* Assess operational health and safety, licensing status, staffing stability, and enrollment continuity of the outgoing operation.
* Coach incoming franchisees through a structured transition plan, including coaching, training, GSL systems access, and licensing notifications.
* Provide time‑bound post‑changeover stabilization guidance focused on early indicators of enrollment continuity, leadership alignment, and operational stability.
* Ensure continuity of child, family, and staff experience throughout the ownership transition.

**Risk Management & Escalation**

* Surface readiness, enrollment, licensing, changeover, and stabilization risks early and clearly.
* Escalate risks promptly when expectations are not being met, partnering with cross‑functional teams to resolve issues.
* Monitor early warning indicators and intervene with targeted support to prevent downstream disruption.

**Coaching, Communication & Collaboration**

* Coach franchisees on curriculum implementation, school readiness, staff onboarding, and brand standards.
* Support franchisees through opening week and/or transfer week, and early operations to reinforce best practices and goal setting
* Provide bi-weekly progress updates to franchisees and internal stakeholders.
* Track milestones, risks, and performance metrics in internal systems.
* Build strong, professional relationships with franchisees and cross‑functional partners.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in early childhood education, Business, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience in early childhood operations, franchise operations, school leadership, or multi‑unit field support.
* Strong knowledge of childcare licensing standards and regulatory compliance.
* Experience with onboarding, project management, or school launches.
* Exceptional communication, coaching, and relationship‑building skills.
* Ability to travel up to 85% for site visits and transitional support.

**Preferred**

* Experience opening new childcare centers or supporting franchise launches.
* Familiarity with operational readiness planning.
* Enrollment management, sales, or tour conversion experience.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and project management tools.

**Key Competencies**

* Ability to manage multiple projects
* Operational & Program Readiness
* Compliance & Licensing Expertise
* Enrollment Growth & Market Activation
* Staffing & Capacity Planning
* Risk Identification & Escalation
* Changeover & Stabilization Support
* Communication & Influence
* Training, Coaching & Feedback
* Relationship Building

jobs.title: Project Manager (Technical & Functional) - EAM, Manufacturing, Implementation - US
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

**Why Ultimo?**

* You work on high‑impact transformation projects, not long, abstract programs
* You deliver visible value fast, customers see results within months
* You join a fast‑growing international SaaS company where growth unlocks new opportunities
* You work in a pragmatic, result-driven culture with experienced professionals
* You get strong onboarding, continuous learning, and real career progression
* Competitive compensation and benefits that grow with your impact

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Why this role and why now?**

Organizations worldwide are under pressure to get more value from their assets, faster. Ultimo is growing rapidly, both globally and in the US, and every North American customer deserves a steady, predictable experience from contract signature to go‑live. That’s why we’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to give each implementation a single, accountable owner.

This is not a status-reporting role. You understand the work well enough to judge whether a project is really on track, and you catch issues while they are still small.

If you enjoy ownership, bringing structure to fast-moving projects, and shaping how a growing team delivers, this is your moment.

**Your impact**

As Project Manager, Technical & Functional, you own the plan, budget, risks, and communication for Ultimo implementations across North America. A customer’s maintenance director and IT lead should each see you as someone who understands their side of the project, from work orders and preventive maintenance to data, integrations, and cutover.

You are trusted to lead the project, not just to track it.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Own scope, plan, budget, resourcing, risks, and issues for North American implementations, from sales handover through go‑live and transition to support
* Receive the sales-to-delivery handover, confirm nothing promised is undocumented, and run the customer kickoff
* Run a consistent communication cadence for customers, internal teams, and subcontractors: weekly status, a shared risk and issue log, steering committees, and clear escalation paths
* Own the change order process, identifying scope change early and securing customer approval before work proceeds
* Act as the single point of contact for support tickets raised on active projects and track each one to resolution
* Coordinate consultants, the Solution Architect, the data migration lead, and internal Ultimo services such as our European practice and product specialists as one team
* Plan and run cutover, go/no‑go decisions, hypercare, and the formal handover to support
* Help build the North American delivery playbook, and use AI tools to reduce administrative effort
* Close projects in a way that turns customers into references

**Qualifications**
------------------

**This role is a great fit if you:**

* Bring 3+ years of experience managing EAM / CMMS / ERP implementations for asset-intensive organizations (IBM Maximo, IFS, SAP PM, MainSaver, or similar)
* Have strong domain knowledge in maintenance work processes, preventive maintenance, inventory, and reliability, and can discuss them with plant and maintenance leaders
* Understand data migration, integrations, and cutover well enough to plan them, judge progress, and ask the right questions
* Have managed fixed-price and time-and-materials projects, raised change orders, and protected margin without damaging the relationship
* Stay calm under pressure, have stabilized a strained project, and deliver difficult messages clearly
* Enjoy turning ad hoc ways of working into simple, repeatable standards that a growing team will actually use
* Have an affinity with AI and emerging technologies, and use AI tools in your daily work
* Communicate confidently and clearly with customers and internal stakeholders
* Take ownership and act proactively, with a genuine commitment to customer success

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**Ready to step up?**

If you’re looking for a role where customers rely on you to keep their implementation on course, and where you can shape how a growing team delivers, this is the opportunity.

This role is remote within the US, ideally based in the Eastern or Central time zone, with regular travel to customer sites for kickoffs, steering committees, and go‑live.

Apply now and help organizations get more out of their assets faster.
